external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app and self-service kiosks to borrow, renew and reserve books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who manage loans and member account blocks through the circulation page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page.
external_entities.notes: The shared login password is on a card taped under the desk.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone through which the member renews loans and reserves titles.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API that handles loans, reservations and circulation operations and is the only component that reads or writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: The lending API is a plain REST service and it is the only way anything touches loans.
processes.notes: The Lending service note says the API is internal-only: "The lending API is internal-only." The Interview transcript says phones reach it over the internet: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." Authentication is unverified; Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where a member scans their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: Every branch has self-service kiosks where a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: Priya corrected the earlier statement about two databases: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request lending operations.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

data_flows.name: renew or reserve
data_flows.description: The library app requests a loan renewal or reservation from the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: The authentication mechanism is uncertain; Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."
data_flows.data_description: book and member identifiers; renewal or reservation request

data_flows.name: send loan or return
data_flows.description: A self-service kiosk sends a loan or return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.notes: The text does not establish whether kiosks also communicate directly with the loans database.
data_flows.data_description: loan or return and scanned library card and book

data_flows.name: change loan account
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses one shared login; the page does not ask again and its history cannot identify the individual or branch.

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: members, loans, reservations and borrowing histories

trust_boundaries.name: member phone
trust_boundaries.description: The phone on which the library app runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and members' full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database."
